messages:
maya: Quick sync — Q2 roadmap planning for on‑prem/VPC deliveries. We have customer asks from Acme + MedServe asking for a private control plane + fully airgapped packaging. Proposal: narrow MVP scope so we can hit end-of-Q2. Thoughts?
raj: +1 on narrowing. security note: KMS integration + signed images will be non-negotiable for enterprise buyers. That likely adds ~2 sprints.
olivia: Can we scope HSM/HSM-integration to post-MVP? Most customers asked for KMS + audit logs, not HSM specifically.
lee: Packaging engineering: we can adapt the existing installer but need offline registry support and preflight checks. Rough estimate: 6 weeks for a 1.0 onprem bundle (with CI for airgap).
sam: Ops POV: automated upgrade path and a rollback plan are must-haves — customers will expect painless patching. If we don't have that, churn risk is high.
maya: Proposed OKR (draft): "Ship onprem control plane MVP + airgap packaging to 2 pilot customers by EoQ2". Success metrics: onboard time <7 days, upgrade success >=95%, <=2 Sev2s in first 30 days.
olivia: Agree on the metrics. We need explicit launch criteria though — can someone draft a checklist?
maya: Draft checklist below — shout if anything missing:
```
- VPC control plane deployable in customer VPC (templates & docs)
- Onprem installer supports airgap: offline image tarball + local registry bootstrap
- KMS integrations for secrets (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Vault)
- Image signing and verification in installer
- Preflight checks and post-install validation suite
- Upgrade orchestration + automated rollback tested
- RBAC + audit logging enabled by default (telemetry optional)
- Runbook + run-through with SOC for pilot customers
- 2 pilot customers onboarded and validated
```
raj: Add: telemetry must be opt-in for airgapped installs; legal will require explicit consent. Also add compliance checklist for data residency.
lee: Build details: support containerd + CRI-O, and include a lightweight offline bundle generator. We'll need a job to produce per-release airgap artifacts.
sam: Can we split into Phase 1 (MVP) / Phase 2 (enterprise+) to reduce scope? Phase 1 = control plane deployable in VPC, airgap installer, KMS basic. Phase 2 = HSM, expanded KMS connectors, multi-cluster management.
maya: That split sounds reasonable. For roadmap prioritization, I'm leaning: MVP (Phase 1) must cover onboarding & safe upgrades. Phase 2 can be driven by large customer demand.
olivia: Risk callout: support burden — if we ship without automated diagnostics and remote debug tooling (even in airgap, via a support bundle), support load will spike. Add a mandatory support-bundle generator to the checklist.
maya: Added. Also we need clear launch criteria for stakeholder sign-off (security, legal, solutions eng). I'll schedule a 30-min review next Tue.
deploy-bot: created ticket RD-4523: "onprem airgap installer - MVP checklist & release plan" assigned to @lee.
lee: I'll spin up a branch and a proof-of-concept artifact generator this week. Expect initial RFC by Friday.
raj: I'll start a short risk doc for KMS/HSM options and regulatory impacts.
maya: Awesome. Action items: 1) Lee: POC + RFC (this week). 2) Raj: KMS risk doc (next Tue). 3) Olivia: pilot customer shortlist + SOC contact. 4) Sam: draft upgrade runbook template. We'll review at Tue sync. :thumbsup:
